patterns: Mostly leader-revolt identification: Santhal = Sidhu-Kanhu; Munda/Ulgulan = Birsa; Kol = Budhu Bhagat; Tana Bhagat = Jatra Oraon (1914).
APPSC tilt: Rampa revolt (1922, Madras Forest Act 1882, Alluri), Rekapalli 1879 forest-law revolt, Paharias and Santhals in the Rajmahal Hills, Paika = Odisha.
Year-matching and chronology items (Santhal 1855-56; Indigo, Deccan Riots, Sepoy Mutiny sequence) and 'not correctly matched' revolt-year pairs.
The app matches the shape well but adds deep AP local-leader detail (Chandrayya, Ambul Reddy, police stations) beyond PYQ depth.
